indicator_definitions.price_change_pct: (latest completed close / close N days ago - 1) * 100
indicator_definitions.rvol: mean volume of latest N days / mean volume of preceding 20 days
indicator_definitions.recent_box: longest trailing 5-20 day high-low range <= 10% of its low
indicator_definitions.distance_from_20d_low_pct: (latest completed close / lowest low up to 20 days - 1) * 100
